name: Timepicker
description: A time selection dropdown that renders a scrollable list of time slots. Supports 12-hour and 24-hour formats, configurable step intervals, and multiple sizes.

notes: The input triggers a time slot dropdown on click or Enter/Space.
Arrow keys navigate through time options in the dropdown.
Escape closes the dropdown and returns focus to the input.
Selected time is announced via aria-selected on the active option.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus).

value.description: The currently selected time as a string (e.g. '09:30' for 24h or '09:30 AM' for 12h).

onChange.description: Callback fired when a time is selected.

step.description: Step interval in minutes between each time slot.

format.description: Whether to show time in 12-hour (AM/PM) or 24-hour format.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when no time is selected.

disabled.description: Disables the timepicker input and prevents opening the dropdown.

size.description: Controls the input height, padding, and font size.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root wrapper element.

do: Always provide an accessible label via aria-label or a linked FormLabel.
Use step to control granularity — 15 for quarter-hour, 30 for half-hour, 60 for hourly.
Pair with Datepicker for full date-time selection.
dont: Do not use for duration input — this is for time-of-day selection.
Do not omit a label — provide aria-label if no visible label is present.
Do not use step values that do not divide evenly into 60 for predictable slot generation.
